label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
**Subject: Lotus Glow Nails Update: Everybody OK, We Reopen Monday Nov 16!**

Hello my dear friends, neighbors, church family, and all my wonderful ladies,

You probably heard already. Early Sunday morning, November 8, around 2am, a car drove right through the front window of Lotus Glow Nails. First the most important thing: **nobody was hurt.** The shop was empty, the driver is OK, the police came, and her insurance will pay for everything. Thank God.

The front glass is gone and one pedicure chair is completely smashed. The car stopped exactly at that pedicure chair, like she really wanted a spa day. My daughter says she got the first drive-thru pedicure in Houston. All the polish fell off the shelves, so now the floor looks like a rainbow threw up. My husband says finally the shop is modern art.

I will be honest, I cried a little Sunday morning. Eleven years on Bellaire Blvd is a lot of memories. But now I am OK. God protected us because nobody was inside, and that is all that matters. Glass and chairs we can fix.

**When we open again:**
The city inspector has to check the wall first, but our contractor says we will **reopen Monday, November 16.**

**Where to find us this week:**
Me, Trang, and Kim are working at my cousin Hoa's salon, **Pearland Nail Bar.** Please call or text my cell at **832-555-0147** and I will set up your appointment. Same faces, same good nails, just a little longer drive!

**Gift cards:** All your gift cards are still good. Nobody loses any money.

Thank you so much for all the texts, calls, prayers, and food. My phone has not stopped ringing and my heart is very full. Special thank you to Mrs. Dung, who brought me pho this morning. It was exactly what I needed.

Please don't worry about me. Just come see me this week in Pearland, and come see the new window at Lotus Glow on the 16th. Maybe I will put up a sign: "No drive-thru, please park outside."

With love and gratitude,

[Your name]
Lotus Glow Nails
